prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage: it says it compares Marketplace and private plans, serves both sides of the Kansas–Missouri line, and reports a 5.0 Google rating across 90 reviews. Call **816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Another option is **AIS Health Advisors** in Overland Park, which says it helps with ACA Marketplace plans and subsidy eligibility at no direct cost: **913-333-8627** or [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker is licensed in your state, which insurers they can compare, and whether your doctors and prescriptions are covered. Your home address matters: Kansas City residents shop plans based on whether they live in Kansas or Missouri. For ACA plans, you can also get unbiased enrollment help through **HealthCare.gov**.
